messages:
ajordan: Heads-up — seeing intermittent loss of route match context (tenant header) in decision logs about ~10s after request start. initial span shows tenant, later spans show tenant=null. not sure if sampler TTL or archiver batching is the culprit.

m_garcia: yikes. can you paste a trace id and a minimal log snippet?

ajordan: trace id 01GZf7QxR... attached below. sample from span chain:
```json
{"span_id":"a1","event":"route_eval","route":"/v1/generate","decision":"match","tenant":"acme-corp","ts":1689801234000}
{"span_id":"a4","event":"route_eval","route":"/v1/generate","decision":"match","tenant":null,"ts":1689801245000}
```

samir: quick check — our sampler default `decision_log_ttl_ms` is 10000 (10s) in prod config. if archiver flush happens >10s later the in-memory sample could be garbage collected.

ops-bot: infra-alert: sample-rate changed to 0.02 in us-west earlier today (deploy #2026.3.20).

m_garcia: archiver job frequency? if archive batches every 15s that's a clear race with 10s TTL.

ajordan: archive batches every 15s AFAIK. that would line up with the gap. looks like ttl < batch window -> dropped tenant on persisted traces.

nora: workaround: bump `decision_log_ttl_ms` to 30000 for the rollout or make archiver flush on route-complete. either works. we should avoid long-lived global TTL increases if we can flush per-request.

samir: I'll draft a small PR to bump to 30s and add a metric `decision_log_ttl_evictions` so we can quantify. also adding a hook to flush on route completion (cheap) as a follow-up.

m_garcia: can we also add a console indicator — per-trace `decision_finalized_at`/`decision_persisted` so SREs can see when we lost context? UX ticket incoming.

ajordan: yes please. also adding test: simulate archiver delay > ttl and ensure archived decision still has tenant.

trace-bot: trace 01GZf7QxR archived -> s3://redwood-decision-logs/2026/03/20/01GZf7QxR.json (size 2.1KB)

ajordan: thanks all — PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/482 (bump ttl + metric). will run a small replay once merged.

m_garcia: once merged let's patch prod config and watch `decision_log_ttl_evictions` on the dashboard (add a short alert if > 0 for 5m).

ajordan: sounds good, closing this thread after verification. :thumbsup:
